Progress will then be monitored on a financial yearly basis.' This gives a timetable for evaluation, reaching toward level 2/3. However, there is no mention of testing the policy before rollout, no explanation of why testing was not appropriate, and no clear statement on publication of results - only internal review and Cabinet Office governance are mentioned ('the Cabinet Office will maintain clear governance... which assures senior and line manager engagement'). Without explicit plans for publishing findings or reasons for testing choices, it cannot reach level 3. It meets level 2 because measures are comprehensive and an evaluation timetable (quarterly data, annual review) is given, but testing is absent and not justified.
